info.title: Voice receptionist
info.summary: Our voice receptionist answers from your own catalog in English or Arabic, shows the product and takes the order.

direction.concept: A closed shop street at night; the pet answers while the shutters are down

scenes.say: Closed at 9? You are still losing orders.
scenes.title: Closed at 9?

scenes.say: Customers keep asking after your door is locked, and nobody is there to answer.
scenes.title: Nobody answers
chat: Hi, are you still taking orders?

scenes.say: This is our voice receptionist. A customer holds one button and asks, in English or Arabic.
scenes.title: English or Arabic
chat: Do you have a chocolate cake?

scenes.say: It checks your own catalog, answers out loud, and shows the product.
scenes.title: Your catalog, your answers
chat: Yes. Here it is, from today's menu.

scenes.say: Then it collects the details and takes the order.
scenes.title: It takes the order

scenes.say: You open your list in the morning, and the order is waiting.
scenes.title: Waiting for you

scenes.say: Want your shop to answer tonight? Comment the word order.
scenes.title: Comment ORDER

caption:
Closed at 9? You are still losing orders.

Our voice receptionist answers from your own catalog, in English or Arabic, shows the product and takes the order.

Comment ORDER and we will send you the details.
